_about: ACE clash_resolve rules. Office copy: %APPDATA%\ACE-RevitMCP\clash-resolve.json (or config.json "clashResolveRules": a path). Project copy: <ACE Vault>\rules\clash-resolve.json, which wins key by key; trim_to_face merges per sub-key. order: one category priority list, strongest cuts (foundation, column, wall, slab, beam, stair, ramp or OST_ names). scope: clashing | all-touching. trim_to_face: a beam or wall end trimmed to the face it runs into, only when allowed (a call can switch it off, never on). max_pairs / chunk_size: all-touching runs in chunks of chunk_size pairs (default max_pairs, 500), each its own dry run, apply and undo step. same_category: true by default (same-category joins are part of the office method); false opts out. preview_required is always true: every apply needs the identical dry run; false is refused.
